points.facet: holding the room when the discharge rollout slipped
points.text: He took the blame for the slipped rollout in front of the clinical directors and set out a two-week recovery plan.

points.facet: what the ward sisters said after the pilot
points.text: Her sisters told her the handover sheet had cut the midnight phone calls, which is not something an engineer usually hears from a ward.

points.facet: rebuilding the discharge forecast from ward data
points.text: He rebuilt the forecast from six months of ward data and found the night-shift gap nobody had costed.

paragraphs.text: The rollout taught me that a plan nobody on the ward has read is a plan that does not exist, so I spent the next month in handover meetings instead of in the backlog.
